visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Bundle the Stack into a Struct
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Loose global variables and repeated index updates implement a stack. Put the array and size in a struct and write push and pop functions that take a pointer to it. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: The stack's data and its size now travel together, the operations have names, and you can create as many stacks as you like instead of being limited to one global one.
